pages.title: Siege Break
pages.creator: Big Wave
pages.description:
Siege Break is a fantasy defense game about holding off attackers before they destroy your base. Drag heroes from the lower panel into empty defensive positions, then press Fight when you are ready for the next wave. Refresh lets you change the hero available for deployment.

Choose where to place your units around the base and watch how the defense holds against each assault. The fortress has a limited health bar, so stopping enemies before they reach it is the central objective. Prepare your lineup between waves and keep the path protected as the siege continues.

pages.title: Sandbox - Destroy the Ragdoll
pages.creator: ThEVlaDGamE
pages.description:
Sandbox - Destroy the Ragdoll is a damage-based clicker with a selection of weapons, characters and backgrounds. Tap the screen to attack your chosen target and earn money from the damage you cause. More powerful attacks bring larger rewards, helping you improve your equipment.

Use the menu to change the setup, then keep attacking to gain money and levels. Progress opens additional weapon types, giving you more ways to damage the ragdoll and develop your firepower.

pages.title: CUBE KING
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
CUBE KING challenges you to manage stacks of numbered cubes before any stack grows too tall. Cubes arrive through portals at regular intervals. Select a cube, then select its destination to move it between rods and combine matching numbers. Merges earn coins that you can spend on cube upgrades, new portals or better starting cubes.

Special effects complicate the stacks: some boosts help, while fire can reduce a cube's value and ice can leave cubes frozen. Use the available remedies and upgrades as you arrange the pieces. Keep enough room for incoming cubes, because an overflowing stack ends the game.

pages.title: CS: Upgrade Gun
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: CS: Upgrade Gun puts you in control of a moving cannon that shoots at targets along its run. Guide the weapon toward useful boosters, improve its performance and try to keep the run going as the action becomes busier. Hold the mouse or a finger in the direction you want to move, steering the cannon through the targets and pickups ahead.

pages.title: Boyfriend For Hire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Boyfriend For Hire is an interactive romance story about Amy, a studious girl whose mother wants her to start dating. Amy hires transfer student Javier to pretend to be her boyfriend, but the arrangement becomes complicated by Christie, rumors and a flirtatious study partner.

Choose outfits and make decisions as the story unfolds. The central question is whether Amy and Javier's relationship will remain an act or develop into something real, with your choices guiding you through the romantic complications.

pages.title: Ship Out
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Ship Out is a harbor puzzle about releasing ships trapped in a crowded arrangement. Slide the vessels to open routes and clear the jam, paying attention to the directions in which each ship can move. Different ships have their own movement restrictions, so an available space is useful only if the right vessel can reach it. Power-ups can help with tougher layouts as new challenges appear.

pages.title: Scroll and Spot
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Scroll and Spot is a Christmas-themed difference puzzle with two pictures that scroll together. Drag the view to explore more of the scene while keeping both images aligned, then tap the details that do not match. Find all five differences to reach the next level. The shared scrolling lets you compare corresponding sections as you search beyond the part of the pictures first shown.

pages.title: Real Racing 3D
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Real Racing 3D is a car racing game built around winning championships and unlocking more vehicles. Start racing with classic cars and work toward adding new ones through your results. WASD handles driving, Space activates drifting and N changes the camera. Use P to pause or leave the race. Keep control of the car while chasing a championship win.

pages.title: Farm Match Seasons 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Farm Match Seasons 2 is a match-three game about helping Poppy care for a farm. Swap crops, fruit and flowers to bring at least three matching items together. Larger combinations produce extra rewards and boosters that help with the puzzles.

The farm's tasks include harvesting strawberries, gathering flowers, protecting butterflies and dealing with weeds. Follow each level's objective as you progress through increasingly demanding fields, choosing matches that contribute to the job rather than clearing pieces without a plan.

pages.title: Tiny Explorer
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Tiny Explorer is a retro platform adventure set in an ancient temple where you are searching for treasure. Work through 27 levels using movement, jumping and a whip, or try the speedrun mode to put your pace to the test. On a keyboard, A and D or the horizontal arrow keys move the explorer; W, I or Up jumps, while Space, U, C or O uses the whip.

pages.title: Alone II
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Alone II continues the story of a man who has left his house and now wants to reach a friend's home. He has lost his bearings, so explore the surroundings and interact with what you find while trying to make sense of the route. Use WASD to move, E to interact and F for the flashlight. Escape pauses the game, and an in-game tutorial introduces its controls.

pages.title: Idle Higher Ball
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Idle Higher Ball is a ball-launching game where pulling a rope sends the ball upward. Slide down to draw the rope back, then bounce the ball toward the glass above. Breaking through it and reaching greater heights increases your score. The stage also requires enough travel distance to succeed, so focus on launching the ball far enough as well as high enough.

pages.title: Brain Master
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Brain Master is a collection of tricky quiz questions and logic riddles. Work out what each problem is really asking instead of relying on the first answer that seems obvious. The puzzles are designed around unexpected solutions, making careful reading and a willingness to reconsider your assumptions central to finding the answer.

pages.title: Hide and Seek | The Original HNS Stickman Game
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Hide and Seek | The Original HNS Stickman Game lets you take either side of a stickman hiding game. As a seeker, search for the other characters; as a hider, find cover and stay outside the seeker's view. Hiding places include desks, cars, water and patches of crops. You can also push other stickmen into view. Move with WASD or swipe across the screen as you search or try to remain concealed.

pages.title: Merge Numbers Wooden edition
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Merge Numbers Wooden edition combines falling number blocks with level objectives. Release a block from above the play area and let it land on another with the same value to merge the pair into their sum. Work toward the target for the current stage, such as producing the required number of a particular block. Plan your drops around the blocks already below so each merge contributes to that goal.

pages.title: Happy Farm Solitaire
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Happy Farm Solitaire presents classic solitaire with farm-themed artwork. Move cards through the seven columns while working toward four separate foundation piles, one for each suit. Every foundation begins with an ace and continues upward through the ranks to the king. Your objective is to sort the cards into those completed piles, considering how each move helps make the next required card available.

pages.title: Parking Jam Out
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description:
Parking Jam Out combines sliding-car puzzles with running a parking business. Move cars out of the crowded lot to clear the jam and collect parking fees. Decide which vehicle can leave next, opening space for the ones still blocked behind it.

The money also supports the business side of the game. Improve your garages and invest in additional locations as you expand the operation. Clearing the cars and allocating your earnings work together, letting you develop the parking business while solving each congested arrangement.

pages.title: Rally All Stars
pages.creator: RodaGames
pages.description: Rally All Stars starts you with an ordinary rally car and lets you earn money toward faster, more powerful vehicles. Drive through the races, work on your performance and build up a collection of cars with different handling characteristics. The Up arrow accelerates, while Left and Right steer. Try the cars you unlock to find how their driving feel changes your approach to a rally.

pages.title: Atomic Puzzle
pages.creator: HyperCarrot
pages.description: Atomic Puzzle is a logic game about removing atoms in a sequence that leaves nothing behind. Select an atom and consider how its removal will affect the molecules that remain. The order matters, so look ahead instead of treating each choice as an isolated move. Work through 50 levels with different atom types, aiming to clear the entire arrangement at the end of every puzzle.

pages.title: Bike Stunts of Roof
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Bike Stunts of Roof sends a cyclist across rooftops filled with obstacles and gaps. Time your jumps and ducks to keep the run going while picking up coins. Those coins can unlock more bikes, giving you additional rides to use on later attempts. Use W and S or the Up and Down arrows to react to the hazards and try to improve your previous record.

pages.title: Panda Escape With Piggy 2
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Panda Escape With Piggy 2 is a jungle platform adventure featuring a panda and a pig. Guide the characters through ten levels, keeping them away from enemies and obstacles that can end their journey. WASD and the arrow keys control movement, and double jumping helps with the platforming. Work through the stages one by one as you help the pair survive their trip through the forest.

pages.title: Stickman Shadow Hero
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Shadow Hero is a combat game about developing a stickman's fighting ability against increasingly dangerous enemies. Combine items to improve his power or defense and use a drone to provide support. Building the hero's strength is part of the action, so consider the equipment combinations as you prepare him for the opponents ahead and their stronger attacks.

pages.title: Carrom with Buddies
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Carrom with Buddies centers on pocketing your carrom pieces while following the rule for covering the Queen. After potting the Queen, follow it with one of your own pieces to secure it. Clear your pieces with the Queen covered before you pot the last one. That requirement makes the order of your successful shots part of the challenge, alongside sending the discs into the pockets.

pages.title: Creative Coloring
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Creative Coloring offers two ways to color its pictures. Follow the reference colors if you want to recreate the supplied design, or choose freestyle and use any shades you prefer. Select colors with the mouse and apply them to the image, comparing your choices with the model or creating a different palette of your own. The game also includes achievements to unlock as you color.

pages.title: Point to Point Happy Animals
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Point to Point Happy Animals turns numbered dots into animal drawings. Follow the numbers in order and connect them with the pencil to reveal each picture. The collection contains 11 animals, including a lion, giraffe and rabbit. Use the mouse or touch controls to trace the sequence, watching the outline take shape as you move from one numbered point to the next.

pages.title: Combo Slash
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Combo Slash is a pin-removal puzzle about helping a princess escape dangerous situations. Work out which pins to pull and in what order so the barriers no longer block a safe route. A different sequence can change the outcome, so inspect the arrangement before removing a pin. Each level presents another set of restrictions to solve while keeping the princess out of danger.

pages.title: Champions Slot
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Champions Slot is a sports-themed slot-machine game with a single payline. Choose your bet and click Spin to set the reels moving, then see which combination of sporting symbols appears. Each spin produces another arrangement on the line. The play centers on selecting a stake, spinning the reels and checking the resulting symbols for a winning combination.

pages.title: Tennis Open 2020
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Tennis Open 2020 puts you into tennis matches where winning points, games and matches is the goal. Take your position on the court and work through the rallies to defeat the player across the net. The game follows tennis rules, so build your score through successful points as you compete in its events and try to reach the top.

pages.title: Baby Food Cooking
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Baby Food Cooking combines preparing food with looking after hungry babies. Make snacks and baby-food creations, then help keep the children fed and content. Use mouse clicks or taps to take part in the cooking and care activities.

pages.title: Perfect Ironing
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Perfect Ironing turns wrinkled clothes into a cleaning-up task. Take control of the iron and move it across the fabric to smooth away the creases. Use the mouse to guide your work, covering the wrinkled sections until the garment looks tidy. Continue through the levels as each piece of clothing gives you another surface to iron.

pages.title: Keep The Goal
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Keep The Goal is a defensive arcade game where balls arrive from different directions and you must stop them from scoring. Tap to react to the incoming shots and keep the run alive while building your score. You can concede three goals before the game ends, making every missed ball reduce the room you have for another mistake.

pages.title: Animal Safari Hunter 2020
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description: Animal Safari Hunter 2020 is a first-person hunting game set across safari and mountain environments. Locate animal targets and line up shots through its hunting and sniper-shooting challenges. You aim from the hunter's viewpoint, engaging targets in the different landscapes as you work on your shooting accuracy.

pages.title: Survival Shooting Xtreme Crazy Pixel Combat
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Survival Shooting Xtreme Crazy Pixel Combat is a shooter featuring blocky soldiers and zombies as enemies. Move through the combat with WASD, aim and shoot with the mouse, and change weapons as you fight. Space jumps, Shift runs and Tab opens the menu. The pixel-styled battles combine moving around the environment with engaging the enemies you encounter.

pages.title: Dangerous Circle 2
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Dangerous Circle 2 challenges you to keep an object orbiting a circle while spikes appear on either side of its edge. Switch between the inside and outside route to avoid the hazards. Every full trip around the circle adds a point, so stay alert for the next spike as you try to complete more rotations without crashing.

pages.title: Flappy Chopper
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Flappy Chopper is a flying arcade game about taking a helicopter as far as possible without hitting the scenery. Use the mouse to control the chopper and avoid rocks and other obstacles along the route. Watch the space ahead and keep adjusting your flight, aiming to extend the distance you survive on each attempt.

pages.title: 3D Crazy Imposible Tricky BMM Bike Racing Stunt
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: 3D Crazy Imposible Tricky BMM Bike Racing Stunt is a motorcycle challenge built around stunt courses. Choose a bike and ride through tracks that include curves, jumps and checkpoints, working toward the end of each level. Keep the motorcycle on the route as you negotiate the course rather than focusing only on speed. Different bikes and track layouts provide further challenges as you progress.

pages.title: call of duty free
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: In call of duty free, complete shooting tasks by eliminating the required number of enemies in a 3D environment. Meeting unlock conditions gives you access to additional weapons, including rifles and sniper guns. Fire with the left mouse button, aim with the right and use the wheel to switch weapons. Shift increases your movement speed as you work through the combat objectives.

pages.title: Pressure Washer
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Pressure Washer is a cleaning game about removing mud from objects such as furniture and toys. Direct the water jet across the dirty areas and uncover the clean surface underneath. Use mouse or touch interaction to carry out the washing, working over the remaining muddy patches until the object has a fresh appearance.

pages.title: Cake Crush Saga
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Cake Crush Saga is a dessert-matching puzzle set around a shop's selection of sweet treats. Bring together at least three identical items to make a match and add to the score. Ice cream, drinks, doughnuts, bread and biscuits appear among the desserts. Keep looking for matching sets as you clear treats and increase the shop's total.

pages.title: ET Game
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: ET Game is a side-scrolling platform adventure about helping an alien complete a journey home. Move through ten stages and overcome the challenges that stand between ET and the end of the adventure. The arrow keys control movement, while X attacks.

pages.title: 2048 Legend
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: 2048 Legend is a number-merging puzzle where every directional move shifts the tiles together. Slide left, right, up or down to bring identical values into contact and combine them into their sum. Build larger numbers while preserving space for further moves. Since the whole board responds to each direction, consider what will happen to every tile before choosing a move.

pages.title: Parcheesi Deluxe
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Parcheesi Deluxe is a Ludo-style board game about getting all your pawns to the goal before the other players. Roll the dice on your turn and move a pawn along the board toward the end of its route. Keep track of which pieces still need to finish, using each roll as you race to bring your full set home first.

pages.title: Moto Maniac
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Moto Maniac is an obstacle-riding challenge set on port docks. Ride through the course as quickly as you can while keeping the bike out of the water and protecting the rider's head. W and S or Up and Down drive forward and backward; A and D or Left and Right adjust the bike's tilt. Balance speed with careful positioning to clear the dockside obstacles.

pages.title: Raft Royale
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Raft Royale combines building a raft with fighting to destroy rival rafts. Expand your floating base while moving around the battlefield and engaging the opposition. Use the mouse or a finger to move, keeping your own raft in the contest as you work toward defeating others.

pages.title: Animals Box
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Animals Box is a catching game where you move a box to collect falling animals. Keep bombs and fire out of it while gathering the safe targets. The action speeds up as you continue, giving you less time to position the box. Collect diamond stars to buy different box appearances in the shop, including animal-themed skins such as a panda or unicorn.

pages.title: Push The Box
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Push The Box is a color-matching movement puzzle about getting squares to stars of the corresponding color. Tap the squares to move them and work out a sequence that brings each one to the right destination. Check the positions of the pieces and stars before acting, using their colors to keep track of which square needs to go where.

pages.title: Connect The Gems
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Connect The Gems is a path-drawing puzzle built around pairs of matching gems. Click or tap a gem and drag a line toward its partner to connect the pair. Study the positions of the remaining gems as you draw the paths, working through the arrangement until the matching pairs are joined together.

pages.title: Gunblood
pages.creator: Andrew Wolf
pages.description:
Gunblood is a western quick-draw shooter with nine computer-controlled duel opponents and four bonus rounds. Choose a character, then place the cursor over the gun barrel at the lower left before the countdown begins. Keep it there until the signal to fire; moving away early pauses the countdown.

When FIRE appears, move your aim onto the opponent and click to shoot. Speed matters, but so does accuracy: your score also accounts for the life remaining after a round. Work on drawing quickly without wasting shots as you progress through the gunfights.

pages.title: Chess
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Chess presents the traditional strategy game on an eight-by-eight board. Move your pieces according to their individual rules, capture opposing pieces and work toward checkmating the enemy king while keeping your own protected. Click a piece to show its available destination squares in blue or green, then click a highlighted square to make the move.

pages.title: Impossible Truck Driving
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Impossible Truck Driving puts you in charge of trucks on a series of driving courses. Choose a vehicle and steer it along the route toward the finish line, using WASD to control the truck. Different levels give you new layouts to negotiate. Take the size of the vehicle into account as you line it up with the course and work toward completing each route.

pages.title: EG True Color
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG True Color asks you to decide whether a displayed color name matches the pencil's color. Choose Yes for a match and No when the two disagree, using the mouse or touch controls to answer. Keep making accurate decisions while watching the timer, aiming to increase your correct total rather than letting the written word distract you from the actual color.

pages.title: Submarine Happy Dive
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description:
Submarine Happy Dive is an underwater distance challenge filled with mines, torpedoes and other obstacles. Use the mouse to guide the submarine, collect coins and keep the dive going without crashing. Missions include reaching distance milestones, collecting coins and picking up power-ups.

The available aids have different effects: a shield protects against an impact, a speed boost helps you move quickly and a sonic blast destroys incoming obstacles. Choose how to use those benefits as you pursue a longer run and work through the submarine's challenges.

pages.title: Funny Cats Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Funny Cats Puzzle is a jigsaw collection containing six cat pictures. Choose an image and a piece count of 16, 36, 64 or 100, then assemble the scattered fragments to rebuild the picture. The four settings let you change how much detail you need to compare. Use the mouse or touch controls to fit the pieces into place and complete each cat scene.

pages.title: EG Traffic Cross
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Traffic Cross challenges you to reach your car without getting hit by passing traffic. The vehicle is 100 steps away, so work your way across the road while watching the vehicles that threaten the route. Use mouse or touch controls to guide the character, looking for chances to advance safely until you reach the waiting car.

pages.title: Face Paint
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Face Paint is a makeover game with spa, face-painting and dress-up salons. Choose a girl and use the salon tools to prepare her face, create a painted design and put together an outfit. The different salons cover more than painting alone, with face-care tools and clothing choices contributing to the makeover.

Use the mouse to select and apply the available tools, colors and items. Try combinations across the salons to coordinate the girl's painted face with her clothes and accessories, building a finished party look from the different customization choices.

pages.title: Dont Touch the Spike
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Dont Touch the Spike is a flying arcade game about keeping a small bird away from spikes. Tap to make the bird jump and adjust its flight as the hazards threaten its path. Keep watching where the spikes are before making the next jump, aiming to continue for as long as you can without touching one.

pages.title: Sniper 3D Target Shooting
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Sniper 3D Target Shooting tests your aim against targets at different ranges. Move with WASD, run with Shift and use L to lock the cursor. The mouse and wheel handle aiming, zooming and firing, while H lets the sniper hold their breath for a steadier aim. Line up each target and use those aiming tools to improve the precision of your shots.

pages.title: Lavender Dream
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Lavender Dream is a fashion game set in Emma and Mia's dream of lavender gardens and flowers. Help both princesses put together makeup and outfits inspired by that theme. Use the mouse to choose their looks, trying different combinations of the available makeup and clothing as you give each girl a style suited to the lavender-filled setting.

pages.title: Rockets Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rockets Coloring Book lets you choose a rocket picture and color it with a brush. Pick the shades you want and apply them to the drawing, creating your own version of the image. Use the mouse or tap controls to select colors and work across the picture, experimenting with the palette until you are happy with the finished design.

pages.title: Blocks Puzzle
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Blocks Puzzle is a shape-fitting game where you drag pieces onto a grid to complete its layout. Compare the outlines of the available blocks with the empty spaces and work out how they fit together. Some challenges also require rotating shapes, adding another way to position a piece. Keep rearranging your choices until the puzzle grid is filled correctly.

pages.title: Robocar Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Robocar Coloring Book contains six pictures to color with a palette of 24 shades. Select a drawing and apply your chosen colors to create a version of the scene. Try different combinations across the pictures as you work on the finished image. The game also provides options to save your colored picture or print it once you are done.

pages.title: Time Jump
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Time Jump is a timing game about jumping over the hands of a clock. Tap to jump and try to clear as many hands as possible, watching their approach before making your move.

pages.title: Blast The Planets
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Blast The Planets is a timing challenge where the strength of your strike depends on a power meter. Watch the meter and tap when it reaches its peak to deliver a stronger blow. Crack the current planet to move on to the next one and build your score, working on the timing of each strike as you continue through the planets.

pages.title: Jelly Friend
pages.creator: Aurora Games
pages.description: Jelly Friend is a chain-matching puzzle where you drag through nearby jellies of the same color. Connect at least three to clear the chain, earning points and building combinations. Successful chains can add time while the timer steadily counts down. Aim to fill the time bar far enough to complete the challenge before it empties, using longer chains and combos to help extend your remaining time.

pages.title: Air Traffic Controller
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Air Traffic Controller puts you in the control tower, directing aircraft toward their landing places. Handle both airplanes and helicopters while keeping their approaches from causing collisions. Decide where the aircraft should land and manage the traffic as it continues arriving. The objective is to keep the airfield operating without an accident for as long as you can.

pages.title: Slenderman VS Freddy The Fazbear
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Slenderman VS Freddy The Fazbear is a third-person horror action game with two opposing stories. Play as Slenderman to collect eight pizzas and fight Freddy and his animatronics, or take Freddy's role and search for eight pages while confronting Slenderman.

Explore the map and deal with the enemies tied to your chosen character's objective. WASD moves, the mouse controls the view, the left button attacks and the right button blocks. Use F to pick up items as you search, combining exploration with combat to complete the confrontation.

pages.title: Dinosaur Spot The Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Dinosaur Spot The Difference asks you to compare dinosaur pictures and find five changes in each level. Look between the corresponding parts of the images and select the details that differ. There is no time limit, so you can examine the scene carefully. Find every difference to open the next level and begin comparing another pair of pictures.

pages.title: Talking Tom Piano Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Talking Tom Piano Time combines styling Tom with playing piano notes for his girlfriend. Help prepare his appearance and use the instrument to make music. The keyboard controls A, S, D, F, G, H, J and K play different notes, letting you try your own sequences while Tom performs at the piano.

pages.title: Sand Worm
pages.creator: ale
pages.description: Sand Worm puts you in control of a giant creature burrowing through the ground. Eat enemies to grow, gather power-ups and fight the troops trying to stop you. The Left and Right arrow keys guide the worm, while touch controls use the corresponding sides of the screen. Keep using its strength against the increasing enemy force as the action continues.

pages.title: A Maze Race II
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description:
A Maze Race II pits your red ladybug against a green computer-controlled bug in randomly generated mazes. Use the arrow keys to reach the yellow food first; the game ends if your rival gets there ahead of you. The computer becomes faster as you advance.

Collect items to change the race. Red wings speed you up, while a green tortoise slows the opponent. A blue arrow reveals the route, and a yellow hammer lets you break part of a wall with Space. Choose when to use those advantages as you find a way to the food.

pages.title: Fidget Spinner Evolution Toy
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: Fidget Spinner Evolution Toy combines tapping a spinner with customizing its appearance. Tap to set the toy turning and earn coins during the timed play, then use the shop to add more options to your collection. Change parts such as the casing, bearings and central button, mixing the available colors and shapes to put together your own spinner design.

pages.title: Speed Pool King
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Speed Pool King is a timed pool challenge about pocketing as many balls as possible before the clock expires. Press near the cue ball, drag to set the direction and strength of the shot, then release to strike. Line up the next attempt as the balls settle, balancing a useful aim with the limited time remaining to increase your score.

pages.title: Allez Hop
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: Allez Hop is a circus-themed climbing game with pinball-like launches and bounces. Help the gymnast gain height while avoiding obstacles, using the launchers encountered along the way. Tap to fire a cannon, or stretch a bungee and release it to send the character onward. Choose the timing and direction of each launch as you work toward a higher climb and a better score.

pages.title: Bomb It Mission
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Bomb It Mission sends robots into arena challenges with different objectives. A mission may ask you to defeat enemies or crocodiles, gather coins, reach a finish line or color the floor tiles. Read the current task before setting out, since winning does not always mean fighting every opponent.

Use the arrow keys to move and Space to activate your weapon. Some missions restrict the equipment you can use, including challenges focused on the rocket launcher or flamethrower. Complete the objective while keeping track of the mission's time and conditions.

pages.title: Snap the Shape: Hawaii
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Snap the Shape: Hawaii is a shape-fitting puzzle in a tropical setting. Drag the supplied pieces onto the board and arrange them so the entire layout is filled using every piece. Return a piece to the selection bar when you want to try it elsewhere, or use a hint for help. Once you have solved a layout, you can work on completing it in a shorter time.
